outputs: The paper focuses on model fingerprinting and erasure rather than specific NLG tasks, but mentions creative writing as an application area of LLMs.

changes_made.explanation: The paper is about fingerprinting removal from LLMs, not about NLG tasks. While LLMs are used and creative writing is mentioned as an application, the paper does not actually study or evaluate NLG tasks. All NLG-related metadata has been removed.
Simplified duplicates and normalized variant names to base forms (PPL instead of Perplexity, ACC instead of Accuracy, etc.)
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper uses LLMs as subjects for fingerprint removal, not as evaluators of generated outputs.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluations are automated using metrics like FSR, PPL, ACC, and SuperGLUE.

overall_notes: This paper is about fingerprint removal from LLMs (model security/safety), not about NLG evaluation. While it uses LLMs and evaluates them, the focus is on removing ownership fingerprints rather than evaluating NLG capabilities. The automatic metrics are used to measure fingerprint removal effectiveness and model performance preservation, not to evaluate generated text quality.
